why_transformers_5x: authority 4.2 registers jacobian-lens at 581d398, whose own pyproject declares transformers>=5.5, so the 4.x line is not an option. The adapter checkpoints agree independently: their config.json uses the v5 conventions dtype and layer_types, and they ship chat_template.jinja as a separate file that older transformers does not read.
dependency_provenance: inherited from the predecessor's Phase 0.5A lock, requirements-jlens.txt, which is an exact resolution already built and executed on this hardware; scipy is the only addition, needed for the one-to-one optimal assignment in authority 6.3

checks: every registered package version matches exactly
jlens.fit is callable at module level
sympy decides a trivial algebraic equivalence (authority 3.6 scoring)
the target architecture is supported natively (authority 8 sets trust_remote_code=false)

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: the build verification layer was written as `RUN python - <<'PY'`, and the classic Docker builder does not support heredocs
defects_found_and_fixed.effect: python read empty stdin, exited 0, and the build passed without executing a single assertion
defects_found_and_fixed.why_it_matters: a check that cannot fail is worse than no check, because it manufactures confidence
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: the verification is now a COPY-ed file, and its PASS line is present in the build log, so it demonstrably ran

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: an ad-hoc probe reported jlens.merge as missing, appearing to contradict authority 4.2
defects_found_and_fixed.effect: would have suggested the registered code pin was wrong
defects_found_and_fixed.actual_cause: the probe was wrong, not the authority: merge() is a classmethod on JacobianLens, and filtering vars() by callable() misses a classmethod on Python 3.11
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: membership is tested with getattr; fit is confirmed at module level and apply, merge and transport on JacobianLens

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: pypi.org resolves only intermittently from this network: one build succeeded against it and the next failed with 'no matching distribution' for a package that plainly exists
defects_found_and_fixed.effect: the build was not reproducible; success depended on which way the intermittency fell
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: the package index is pinned to a mirror that answers reliably
defects_found_and_fixed.why_not: every version remains pinned by requirements-jlens.txt and the fully resolved set is frozen into the image, so this changes where bytes come from and not which bytes they are

contents_boundary.why: the image is a runtime only, so it can be rebuilt and published without touching the licence position in authority 3.7

azure.note: built locally on the GPU host; authority 2.5 forbids creating any Azure resource, including an ACR
